label: Blind sample burn 002: MTBS Angel Springs fire, WA, 2018-08-02

verdict.headline: No real change
verdict.statement: Radar backscatter (VH) fell by 0.7 dB relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 2 Aug 2018 (90% interval −1.0 dB to −0.4 dB). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). The interval rules out a meaningful change beyond what the controls did.
reasons: a change of at least 1.0 dB in radar backscatter (VH) is ruled out by the interval

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar passes every test on its own: radar backscatter (VH) −0.7 dB, interval −1.0 to −0.4.

notes: only 25 cells share the area's land cover (grassland); land-cover filter relaxed
kept cells within 150 m of the area's elevation (683 m)
ranked by pre-event similarity; kept the best 80
